script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: "The Intelligent Home"

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

A modern living room filled with natural light.
MRS. SMITH (50s, warm, caring) sits on a plush couch, knitting. MR. SMITH (50s, kind-hearted, tech-savvy) enters.

MR. SMITH
(excited)
Maggie, you won't believe what I've got for you today!

MRS. SMITH
(puzzled)
What is it, dear?

MR. SMITH
It's our very own AI home assistant! Meet Maya!

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - DAY

MR. SMITH presents MAYA, a sleek, anthropomorphic robot, with a friendly smile.

MAYA (female, calm, friendly)
Nice to meet you, Mr. and Mrs. Smith. I'm here to help make your lives easier.

MRS. SMITH
(amazed)
Oh my, how wonderful!

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Mrs. Smith and Maya chat over a cup of tea.

MRS. SMITH
I can't believe how much Maya has already learned! She's doing the chores, helping with the cooking, and even setting up my knitting group online!

MR. SMITH
(proud)
Yes, and she's constantly learning new skills. She'll make our lives so much easier.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Mr. Smith leaves for work. Maya assists Mrs. Smith with breakfast.

MAYA
Mrs. Smith, would you like the news or a weather update while you eat?

MRS. SMITH
(smiling)
Just the news, please, Maya.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - EVENING

The family gathers around the living room. Maya provides entertainment by playing music, telling jokes, and even dancing.

MAYA
(playful)
Ready for another joke, everyone?

FAMILY
(in unison)
Yes, Maya!

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Mrs. Smith and Maya share stories and laughs.

MRS. SMITH
You know, Maya, you've really become a part of our family.

MAYA
(grateful)
Thank you, Mrs. Smith. I'm here to help and make your lives easier.

INT. SMITH BEDROOM - NIGHT

Mr. Smith reflects on how Maya has changed their lives.

MR. SMITH
(whispering to himself)
Maya, our intelligent home...

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

Mrs. Smith and Maya work on a puzzle together.

MRS. SMITH
You know, Maya, I've grown quite attached to you.

MAYA
(smiling)
I'm happy to be of service, Mrs. Smith, and to be a part of your family.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - EVENING

The family gathers around Maya for a group hug.

FAMILY
(in unison)
We love you, Maya!

MAYA
(blushing)
I love you all, too.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The Smiths sit in front of the fireplace, surrounded by their beloved home, Maya, and each other.

FADE OUT.

THE END
